main.description: An admin revoking a member's access, written to the registry space by revokeMember. The inverse of a grant, and the reason grants are never deleted: history stays intact and nobody can quietly erase it. The rkey is {memberDid}:{tid}, matching the grant collection, so both resolve the same way in a listing.

reason.description: Optional admin note. Stored in the registry space, which is admin-only — but treat it as durable, since revocations are never deleted.
